def solve():
    bal = Q(180000)
    rate = Q("0.045")
    months = 24
    cash = Q(50000)
    prepay = Q(5000)
    allowance = bal * Q("0.15")
    fee = max(prepay - allowance, Q(0)) * Q("0.02")
    new_bal = bal - prepay
    interest = new_bal * rate * Q(months, 12)
    remaining = cash - prepay - fee
    credit = min(remaining * Q("0.04") * Q(months, 12), interest)
    net = interest - credit + fee
    return {
        "final": net,
        "prepayment_fee_usd": fee,
        "loan_interest_usd": interest,
        "offset_credit_usd": credit,
    }
